'''Tanij''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where he sold [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and other [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] to agents of the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Tanij first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Speeder Vendor aboard Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
